dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.

Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Page bound calendar and project/history sources completely; source identity and current Eastern business-date observations are required.
Use birthday_check.py after its runbook refresh; 30-day window and exact date plus exact confirmed name/alias crosswalk control.
Only verified sent/purchased/ordered evidence for exact occurrence closes it; prior-year, pending, selected or unknown purchase detail cannot.
Keep scoped holds visible; any current-window unknown prevents all-clear. No fuzzy family identity or inferred leap-day occurrence.
Resolve current schedule time/timezone and capable source refresh bridge; later user gift decisions are separate from this read-only review.

success_checks: Private normalized inputs and output packet read back under same request identity; repeated changed inputs with same ID fail closed.
Known eligible occurrences and unresolved holds remain distinct; partial source never becomes an empty or completed family list.
Existing task output matches saved packet; no cart, purchase, contact or automatic Todoist choice applied.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
